claims.label: Trump publicly criticized Candace Owens calling her "low IQ"
claims.claim: Trump's Truth Social post called Candace Owens "an extremely low IQ individual" and described her attack on the First Lady of France as "despicable."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the post on Truth Social directly and confirm timestamp; identify authorship via platform logs.

claims.label: Washington Post reported Secret Service officers fired at WHCD suspect
claims.claim: The Washington Post reported surveillance footage shows the moment Secret Service officers fired at the WHCD suspect, Cole Allen.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the Washington Post article directly; review surveillance footage; verify Secret Service statements.

claims.label: Evan Hill reported no footage of Allen firing weapon
claims.claim: Investigative reporter Evan Hill reported on X that a review of surveillance footage found no indication that Cole Allen fired his weapon at the WHCD incident.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull Evan Hill's X post directly; verify Washington Post's review of footage; cross-reference with official statements.

claims.label: Sara Sidner first shared clip of Erika Kirk "I just want to go home"
claims.claim: The host says the original public clip of Erika Kirk's "I just want to go home" remark was first shared by CNN's Sara Sidner.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via Sidner's public posts or CNN's records; the host could not confirm Sidner personally recorded the clip.

claims.label: Host offers a $10,000 bounty for opposite-side footage of the Erika Kirk corridor clip
claims.claim: After saying she could not confirm that Sara Sidner shot the Erika Kirk "I just want to go home" clip, the host offers $10,000, with source protection, to anyone who has footage from the opposite side of the corridor showing the person who recorded it, and directs tips to candaceowens.com.
claims.investigative_direction: Track bounty submissions received through candaceowens.com; compare any opposite-side footage against the Sidner clip to identify the original recorder (N-10583).
claims.transcript_snippet: I will offer $10,000 to somebody who has the opposite side footage.

claims.label: Baron Coleman commented on WHCD media frenzy
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Baron Coleman comments on the WHCD media coverage, saying Erika Kirk and the ballroom announcement became the focal points of the event; the host agrees.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull Baron Coleman's clip or post directly for full context.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Kirk Released a Pre-Recorded 9-Minute Video Statement
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk published a 9-minute pre-recorded video statement, with the remaining almost two hours of her show consisting of Charlie Kirk clips.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the video directly on Erika Kirk's platforms; review production metadata if available.

claims.label: Erika Kirk claimed she attended WHCD to confront journalists
claims.claim: In her pre-recorded statement, Erika Kirk said she attended the White House Correspondents Dinner because many of the journalists in the room had attempted to dehumanize her and she wanted to meet some of them face-to-face.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the full statement transcript; identify the Daily Mail journalist mentioned.

claims.label: Erika Kirk claimed Candace Owens accused her of murdering her husband
claims.claim: In her pre-recorded statement, Erika Kirk claimed Candace Owens has publicly accused her of murdering her husband.
claims.investigative_direction: Search Candace Owens' full podcast archive for any explicit accusation of murder; review the December text message chain.

claims.label: Erika Kirk criticized journalists for filming during active shooter
claims.claim: In a pre-recorded statement the host plays, Erika Kirk criticizes journalists present at the dinner for using their phones to capture video during what she describes as an active shooting situation.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference against the Sara Sidner footage and other journalist videos; verify the timing of any "active shooter" declaration.

claims.label: Erika Kirk criticized Jimmy Kimmel's Melania joke
claims.claim: In a pre-recorded statement the host plays, Erika Kirk criticizes Jimmy Kimmel's joke about Melania Trump having "the glow of an expected widow."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Kimmel's original monologue; confirm Erika's quotation is accurate.

claims.label: Host Says Terryl Farnsworth Recorded Video at Charlie Kirk Shooting Scene
claims.claim: The host says Terryl Farnsworth recorded himself on video at the Charlie Kirk shooting scene within seconds (she also says not even a minute) of the incident; in a clip she plays, he says "They just shot Charlie."
claims.investigative_direction: Review the Farnsworth video; verify timestamp and original upload context; cross-reference with other scene footage.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet presented a text message screenshot
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Kolvet publicly presented a screenshot of a text message exchange involving Candace Owens as supporting evidence for Erika Kirk's murder claim.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the screenshot; obtain the full conversation thread; host has publicly authorized release of the entire chain.

claims.label: Text message contained "why did you murder your husband?" with cry emojis
claims.claim: The text message presented by Andrew Kolvet contained the phrase "why did you murder your husband?" with cry emojis, framed as Candace's planned first question for Erika.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the exact text against the screenshot; obtain the surrounding messages for context.

claims.label: Candace stated the text was sent in December before meeting Erika
claims.claim: Candace stated the text was sent in December 2025 in response to questions about planned questions for an upcoming meeting with Erika Kirk, framed as a joke referencing the Bari Weiss/Ben Shapiro framing that any question to Erika equaled accusing her of murder.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the timeline of the meeting and the text; obtain the full chain; verify the Bari Weiss/Ben Shapiro framing.

claims.label: Laura Loomer made a recorded rant containing racial commentary about Candace
claims.claim: Laura Loomer appeared in an audio recording making comments about Candace Owens including racial characterizations and descriptions of personal history.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the source recording; identify context and any other parties present.

claims.label: Laura Loomer tweeted SPLC paid Candace $500K to communicate David Duke talking points
claims.claim: The host says Laura Loomer reported that Candace Owens was potentially paid half a million dollars by the Southern Poverty Law Center to communicate David Duke talking points, framed as "Was the SPLC paying Candace Owens 500K a year to plagiarize David Duke?"
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the tweet directly; cross-reference SPLC public records; verify any financial relationship.

claims.label: Laura Loomer claimed Candace was at anti-Trump summit in Rome
claims.claim: Laura Loomer tweeted a question whether Candace Owens, Nick Fuentes, and Aubrey Laitsch, who all "suddenly appeared in Rome", were converging for a "secret anti-Trump summit", adding that she suspects it is funded by foreign dark money and citing a source that Aubrey approached conservatives about a paid propaganda trip to Qatar.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the tweet; cross-reference against actual attendees in Rome during the relevant dates.

claims.label: Candace traveled to Rome with her family for confirmation
claims.claim: Candace stated she traveled to Rome with her husband and children for her Catholic confirmation by a cardinal in the old Latin rite, and that her priest flew in from London.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify through confirmation records or attendee corroboration; the host referenced her March 2026 announcement.

claims.label: Photo Trump shared was originally posted by Candace in 2019
claims.claim: Candace stated the photo of her that Trump used in his Truth Social post was originally shared by Candace herself on her Twitter account in August 2019.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the original August 2019 tweet directly on Candace's Twitter/X account.

claims.label: Candace was sick in 2016 from toxic mold exposure in her apartment
claims.claim: Candace stated that in 2016 she became ill with severe symptoms including eczema, hair loss, and cognitive impairment after a toxic mold exposure in her apartment from an HVAC leak.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via medical records; the underlying photo is the primary artifact anchor.

claims.label: Candace shows August 2016 photos taken three months before the photo Trump shared
claims.claim: Candace shows photos of herself from August 2016, including hiking with her cousins without makeup, and says the photo Trump shared was taken just three months later, when she was very sick.
claims.investigative_direction: Match the August 2016 photos and the photo Trump posted to their original posting dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: The picture that Trump shared was taken just 3 months later.

claims.label: Host says Trump's post was the fourth tweet about her in two weeks
claims.claim: The host says Trump's Truth Social post about her was the fourth tweet about her in a span of two weeks.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull Trump's Truth Social posts mentioning Candace Owens for the two weeks before April 29, 2026 and count them.
claims.transcript_snippet: Yeah, this is actually the fourth tweet about me in the span of 2 weeks from the leader of the free world.

claims.label: Host says Trump had already called her low IQ and uglier than Brigitte Macron
claims.claim: The host says Trump had already called her low IQ and had asserted that she was uglier than Brigitte Macron, so the post repeated earlier points.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the earlier Trump posts or remarks calling the host low IQ and comparing her appearance to Brigitte Macron's.
claims.transcript_snippet: He called me low IQ. He's already asserted that I was uglier than Brigitte, that actually between the two of us it's not even close.

claims.label: Host says Washington runs on blackmail and secrets
claims.claim: The host says Washington, D.C. runs on blackmail and secrets, with operators sent to find embarrassing secrets and offer targets a choice between complying and exposure.
claims.investigative_direction: No documentary test; the host gives no named case in this passage. Treat as a sweeping characterization.
claims.transcript_snippet: By now, you are plenty aware that Washington, D. C. runs on blackmail and secrets, right?

claims.label: Host says the photo Trump shared is real and not AI
claims.claim: The host says the photo of her that Trump shared is authentic and not AI-generated.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the photo in Trump's post with the host's original 2019 post to confirm it is unaltered.
claims.transcript_snippet: the photo he shared of me, to be clear with you guys, it is real. It is not AI.

claims.label: Host says Loomer spent four days sharing AI photos, hit-and-run stories and secret-trust claims
claims.claim: The host says that in the four days before the Trump post, Laura Loomer shared AI photos, stories about drunken hit-and-runs and claims about secret trusts to hide money from the Macrons.
claims.investigative_direction: Review Laura Loomer's X posts from the days before April 29, 2026 for the AI photos, hit-and-run story and trust claim.
claims.transcript_snippet: 4 days of his top advisor, Laura Loomer, sharing AI photos, illusory stories about drunken hit-and-runs, and fairy tales about secret trusts to hide money from the Macron

claims.label: Host says she had two asthma attacks that put her in hospital during the 2016 illness
claims.claim: The host says that during her 2016 illness she had two asthma attacks that landed her in the hospital.
claims.investigative_direction: Medical records, if the host chooses to release them; otherwise a personal account only.
claims.transcript_snippet: I had two asthma attacks that landed me in the hospital and I had no idea what was happening.

claims.label: Host says a doctor put her on a strict candidiasis diet
claims.claim: The host says a doctor told her the only way to beat the infection was a very strict candidiasis diet with no sugar, including fruit sugar.
claims.investigative_direction: Personal medical account; no record cited on air.
claims.transcript_snippet: It's a very strict, uh, candidiasis diet and um, okay, I said, this is just what my life is going to have to be.

claims.label: Host says she started her political YouTube channel in August 2019
claims.claim: The host says that in August 2019 she started her political YouTube channel for the first time, and that her cousin Mia filmed her and helped upload the first video.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the upload date of the first video on the host's YouTube channel.
claims.transcript_snippet: in August of 2019, I started for the first time my political YouTube channel, having no idea how successful it would be.

claims.label: Host says the magazine cover text read that she lies and uses rich white men
claims.claim: The host says the words on the Trump-linked magazine-style cover read that Candace Owens lies, lies, lies and uses rich white men, and earlier said she shared the photo publicly, which is why someone could put it on an AI cover.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the cover image Trump shared and confirm its wording and whether it was AI-generated or an authentic Time cover.
claims.transcript_snippet: Candace Owens lies, lies, lies, and uses rich white men.

claims.label: Host says her husband could not work until he had a green card
claims.claim: The host says that because of immigration law her husband was not allowed to work until he got a green card, so her income alone supported the household for almost two years of engagement and marriage.
claims.investigative_direction: Immigration timeline and work-authorization dates for George Farmer, if disclosed.
claims.transcript_snippet: we were entirely supported by my income, because he was not allowed to work until he got a green card

claims.label: Host says she had a million-dollar book deal and sold about 800,000 copies
claims.claim: The host says she had no debts and a million-dollar book deal when she met her husband, and that she thinks about 800,000 copies of her first book were moved.
claims.investigative_direction: Publisher contract and sales data (Nielsen BookScan or publisher statements) for the host's first book.
claims.transcript_snippet: I had a million-dollar book deal when I met him. I think we moved 800,000 copies of my first book.

claims.label: Host says her parents were not wealthy and her husband's family has generational wealth
claims.claim: The host says her mother did not graduate high school, her father was a plumber for most of his life, and that her husband's family has generational wealth.
claims.investigative_direction: Personal biography; no document cited on air.
claims.transcript_snippet: my mother did not even graduate high school. My father was a plumber for most most of his life.

claims.label: Host says her source says Loomer ranted about not being invited to the WHCD
claims.claim: The host says she is told that Laura Loomer was ranting to people about not being invited to the White House Correspondents Dinner in the period before the Trump post.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the host's source and any third party who heard Loomer's comments about the WHCD.
claims.transcript_snippet: she was ranting ranting to people uh because this is when she was deep in the throes of her psychosis about how she wasn't invited to the White House Correspondents Dinner

claims.label: Host says Loomer demanded a tweet of support from Trump
claims.claim: The host says Laura Loomer demanded a tweet of support from Trump, and that this explains the race-tinged language of the Trump post.
claims.investigative_direction: Corroborate through White House staff, Loomer's own statements, or Truth Social posting logs.
claims.transcript_snippet: she demanded a tweet of support from Trump. In fact, that is what does explain the hint of racism behind the tweet.

claims.label: Host says she has never been to Greenwich, Connecticut
claims.claim: The host rejects Laura Loomer's audio account of her, saying she did not go to clubs in high school and has never in her life been to Greenwich, Connecticut.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Loomer's audio source (the voice on the recording) against the host's school and residence history.
claims.transcript_snippet: who's going to the club in high school I've never in my life actually been out in Greenwich Connecticut.

claims.label: Host says Susie Wiles was staunchly opposed to the Trump post
claims.claim: The host says she is told that White House chief of staff Susie Wiles was staunchly opposed to the Trump tweet.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the host's source and seek confirmation from White House staff.
claims.transcript_snippet: I am told specifically that Susie Wiles was staunchly opposed to credit to Susie Wiles.

claims.label: Host relays a long-standing rumor that Loomer has blackmail on Trump
claims.claim: The host relays a long-standing rumor that Loomer has blackmail on Trump, tied to Loomer claiming relations with him after going on Air Force One, while saying she is reticent to believe it because it is Loomer.
claims.investigative_direction: No evidence offered; any real test would require identifying the rumor's origin and Loomer's Air Force One travel record.
claims.transcript_snippet: There has been of course a very long standing rumor that it's because she has blackmail on him a rumor but I'm reticent to believe right because it's Laura Loomer

claims.label: Host quotes Loomer as threatening to post officials' family members
claims.claim: The host quotes Laura Loomer as saying she will not stop and will post their grandkids, mother and father until she gets what she wants, and calls it emotional blackmail.
claims.investigative_direction: Find the Loomer statement being paraphrased and the people it was aimed at.
claims.transcript_snippet: I won't stop I'll post your grandkids your mother your father I'll I won't stop until I get what I want

claims.label: Host says Trump's attacks on Tucker Carlson and Megyn Kelly track Loomer's focus of the week
claims.claim: The host says Trump's posts attacking Tucker Carlson and Megyn Kelly followed whoever Laura Loomer was attacking that week.
claims.investigative_direction: Line up the dates of Trump's posts about Carlson and Kelly against Loomer's posts on the same targets.
claims.transcript_snippet: why did he send out this crazy tweet about Tucker Carlson or Megyn Kelly? If you go on to Laura Loomer's feed, you will see that it's her focus of the week.

claims.label: Host says Trump does not send his own tweets; Scavino did, and Natalie Harp reportedly does
claims.claim: The host says Trump has never pushed send on his own tweets, that this was Dan Scavino's job in the first term, and that it is widely reported to be Natalie Harp's job on Truth Social.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify who operates the Truth Social account (reporting on Harp and Scavino) and who posted the April 2026 message.
claims.transcript_snippet: Trump, who has never, by the way, pushed send on his own tweets, that was the job initially of Dan Scavino during his first term.

claims.label: Host says only Secret Service agents fired at the WHCD checkpoint
claims.claim: The host says a man stormed a security checkpoint at the White House Correspondents Dinner and only Secret Service agents began firing their weapons, which she reads as likely friendly fire.
claims.investigative_direction: Official incident report, ballistic findings and the Washington Post surveillance footage.
claims.transcript_snippet: a man stormed a security check at the White House Correspondents Dinner, and then Secret Service agents, and only Secret Service agents began firing their weapons.

claims.label: Host says most people inside could not hear or distinguish the sounds at the WHCD
claims.claim: The host says most people inside the ballroom could not hear or distinguish the sound of what was going on and inferred a shooting from the Secret Service rushing the president out.
claims.investigative_direction: Attendee accounts and ballroom audio or video from the dinner.
claims.transcript_snippet: the majority of the people uh could not that were inside could not even hear or distinguish the sound of what was going on.

claims.label: Host says Kolvet honestly said he did not know what the sound was at the WHCD
claims.claim: The host credits Andrew Kolvet with honestly recounting that he heard a sound he did not recognize, and says it could have been plates crashing.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Kolvet's on-air or posted account of the WHCD and compare wording.
claims.transcript_snippet: who, when he recounted the story, uh was actually honest. He said he heard a sound. He honestly did not know what it was.

claims.label: Baron Coleman says Erika said the line as she crossed the only camera
claims.claim: Baron Coleman, in a clip played by the host, says Erika Kirk happened to say "I just want to go home" right as she crossed the only camera that captured her leaving, and calls the aftermath "operation Erika Kirk" following "operation ballroom".
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Coleman show segment and the hotel and press camera positions in the corridor.
claims.transcript_snippet: I just want to go home, and she just happened to say that right as she crossed the only camera that captured her leaving.

claims.label: Host says neither Charlie Kirk nor Trump as president attended the WHCD
claims.claim: The host says the White House Correspondents Dinner was an event that Charlie Kirk never attended and that Trump never attended as president.
claims.investigative_direction: Check WHCD attendance records for Charlie Kirk and for Trump's presidential terms.
claims.transcript_snippet: An event that did not in any way require her presence, one which not even Charlie Kirk had ever attended.

claims.label: Host says the Vice President lectured her camp about not keeping Erika safe
claims.claim: The host says that after the UGA no-show, the Vice President lectured the host's side about not keeping Erika Kirk safe, though the host says her side had not told Erika not to go.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Vance remarks about Erika Kirk's safety around the UGA cancellation.
